# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Identify which days or times of the day the monitoring records show excessive emissions.
3. Order an EPA Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) request from:

  1. State TCEQ: http://www.tceq.texas.gov/agency/contacts/foia.html
  2. Unregulated polluters: http://www2.epa.gov/foia/environmental-protection-agency-epa-requests-epa-sponsored-or-funded-research-records (NOTE: See this report about the EPA's problems with the FOIA requests: http://media.greatnorthwest.org/resources/files/misc/foia.pdf )

A sample FOIA request for TCBC could state:

Please send an electronic copy of all data analyzed using the HP 5890 or Agilent 5890 FID (no PID) Gas Chromatograph (GC) and the M
